tex_content.label: claim:flowline-exists-for-x
tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[Existence of a backward flowline] For each $x\in U_n\subset M_n$ there is a flowline $\{ x\} \times (-R(x)^{-1},0]$ in ${\mathcal M}_n$, and its scalar curvature is at most $R(x)$. \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch A strong $\epsilon $-neck centered at $x$ supplies the flowline and the curvature bound.

□
